installation_requirements: Supply coqc, coqchk, rocq and rocqchk in the wrapper search directories, in this order: /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin, /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin. The wrapper replaces the invoking shell PATH.
Install the Rocq core, runtime and Stdlib logical namespace.
Match every compiler binary and installed-library tree digest in PINNED-TOOLCHAIN.json.
The wrapper rejects an installation whose bytes differ from the pin.
